title: Sky Sail Balloons Inc
specs: Flights typically last about one hour; total experience about three hours including setup and celebration
Flights launch from various sites around Chautauqua Lake with possible special request flights
Experienced pilot with over 100 hours balloon flight time; state of the art equipment
Disclose full weight clothed on passenger information form; flights subject to weight limits varying with conditions; party weight limit approx 900 lbs
Passengers must understand and follow pilot's ground briefing and directions during flight
No smoking near balloon or vehicles; no alcohol before flight; visibly intoxicated passengers not carried
Passengers must fill out medical questionnaire and certify fitness for flight; may require doctor's consent if health concerns
Children under 10 not recommended due to safety and behavior concerns
Passenger must sign waiver acknowledging risks and responsibilities
Private rides for up to four people subject to weight limits; additional riders may be added on day of flight
